title: Closing costs by U.S. state, 2026
description: Seller and buyer closing costs in all 50 states and the District of Columbia on a $400,000 home and at each state’s median home value: title insurance where each side usually pays for it, settlement, recording and attorney fees, lender charges, and the state and local taxes each side usually pays. State-set costs come from statutes and agencies; other fees are national estimates, stated in the methodology.
notes: Also published with charts and methodology at https://brokerandagent.com/research/closing-costs-by-state
